newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine second airline boosts passenger volume.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine second airline boosts passenger volume.

text.p: Ukraine International Airlines (UIA), the country's second largest carrier, boosted passenger volume to 178,000 in 1996, from 152,000 in 1995, vice president Yuri Miroshnykov said on Tuesday.
He said the airline expected to carry between 180,000 and 200,000 passengers this year. UIA, set up five years ago, carried 114,000 passengers in 1994.
UIA, a joint venture with the Irish aircraft leasing company GPA Group plc, serves 12 destinations, mostly in western Europe, with two leased Boeing 737-200 jets.
Last November Austrian Airlines and Swissair together took an 18.37 percent stake in UIA, investing $9 million. UIA's total share capital is $49 million.
The company made a profit of $1.5 million last year and Miroshnykov said it expected to make no less in 1997.
